items.title: Darnell Howard Interview, 1957-04-21
items.q: Piron, I remember him very well too. Did you know Piron? Very well.

ctx.x: Was it the same approach to the instrument? No. Well how was it different?

I can't answer that because it's been too long, honestly. I mean it is not the one answer, I just don't remember, that's a long time of course. He's speaking about 1922. Piron, I remember him very well too. Did you know Piron? Very well. Was he a good violin player? Yeah. But I mean they didn't play any too hard, they played variations, you know what I mean, the oblicatas, you know. Did you play violin the same way you played clarinet? Use the same ideas and the same? Yeah. I do now. You do now. Listen I got a…
You have better technique on fiddle than on clarinet? Yeah.
